clips.text: Your letter has filled my heart with joy.
You are at the threshold of a great revolution; now, even if you want to run away I will not let you.
You will certainly have to perish in it so that you can be reborn.
Gold has to pass through fire - only then is it purified.
Love is fire for you, and I pray to God that your ego burns in it.
Then if love comes, prayer can come too; without love prayer is not possible.
Remember that body and soul are not two.
The part of the person that can be seen is the body, the part that cannot be seen is the soul.
The same holds true for God and matter: God made visible is matter, and what cannot be seen is God Take life easily and naturally, just as it comes.
